messages:
emma_csm: FYI EmberForms renewal ~38 days out. Usage dropped ~48% month-over-month, active seats 275 -> 143. Their main champion transitioned roles last Friday.

infra-bot: Automated alert: acct_emberforms usage delta -48% (30d) vs baseline. Alert ID: UDA-20260415-07.

liam_ae: thanks emma. Any error telemetry or billing flags? Procurement mentioned a competitor demo but no formal RFP yet.

raj_se: integration pings show repeated 502/timeout during midnight UTC batch windows last week. Quick excerpt: ```
2026-04-15T00:12:47Z WARN 502 /v1/webhook acct=emberforms req=hb-44
2026-04-15T00:12:48Z ERROR 504 /v1/webhook acct=emberforms req=hb-45
2026-04-15T00:15:02Z ERROR 429 /v1/generate acct=emberforms pid=gw-11
```

emma_csm: that lines up with when their scheduled sync jobs started failing. New PM listed as "P. Liao" in Okta but hasn't responded to our outreach.

sara_cs_manager: propose two waves: (1) immediate reliability triage with infra + SE; (2) outreach + commercial retention offer once we confirm root cause.

liam_ae: approved retention offer: 3-week migration sprint (up to 12 SE hours) + $5k service credit if they agree to a 6-month renewal. Hold exact terms until we confirm errors.

raj_se: I'll run a quick root-cause scan on gw-11 and the webhook proxy. ETA 6 hours. If errors on our edge, we'll patch and backfill any lost requests.

emma_csm: action items: raj -> infra scan & log summary, liam -> contact procurement and new PM, emma -> prep account health brief and invite for a technical triage slot.

infra-bot: Reminder: create renewal_watch ticket in Salesforce (acct_emberforms, renewal_38d) 1 RW-20260415-09.

emma_csm: SF ticket RW-20260415-09 created and linked to onboarding-rescue playbook. I'll post audit results here when ready. :white_check_mark:
